name: Twistlock - Compliance Violations
description: The Twistlock - Compliance Violations dashboard provides detailed information on system-wide compliance violations, organized according to severity of violation, description of violation, and rules triggered by the violation.
title: Twistlock - Compliance Violations

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Twistlock type log_type "container_scan" containerCompliance severity
| parse regex "\s+(?<component>Twistlock-Console|Twistlock-Defender?)\s*.*\s*time=\"" nodrop
| parse "type=\"*\"" as type nodrop | parse "log_type=\"*\"" as log_type nodrop | parse "compliance_id=\"*\"" as compliance_id nodrop | parse "severity=\"*\"" as severity nodrop | parse "description=\"*\"" as description nodrop | parse "rule=\"*\"" as rule nodrop | parse "host=\"*\"" as host nodrop | parse "container_id=\"*\"" as container_id nodrop | parse "container_name=\"*\"" as container_name nodrop
| where type matches "container_scan" and log_type="containerCompliance"
| count_distinct(container_id) as container_ids by severity
| sort by container_ids, severity asc
